issue.title: test_bench_axe_jk Services (Axe) cached j/k exceeds its 16 ms p95 budget on athena, now that sample isolation lets latency evaluation run
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1vy.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) of epic sase-1vy; filed by
the sase-1vy land agent.

Before a4bbd29cba (sase-1vy.3, the sase-199 fix), `test_bench_axe_jk` failed its
exact tab-set assertion before it reached latency evaluation, so its 16 ms p95 budget
was never actually enforced. With the Services sample window isolated (bench starts on
`SERVICES_TAB`, selects rows by app_instance_id + services tab + next/prev +
perf_counter window, and proves the durable window is complete), the latency assertion
now runs and fails:

- fixed tree, run 1: next p95 34.31 ms / prev p95 13.53 ms (20 + 20 samples,
  tab == services, window-complete passes)
- fixed tree, run 2: next p95 38.63 ms / prev p95 34.13 ms
- clean base (pre-fix HEAD): next p95 35.60 ms / prev p95 31.60 ms, plus the old
  tab-set contamination failure at bench_tui_jk_panes.py:91

So the over-budget latency reproduces identically on and off the feature tree; the
sample-window fix uncovered it but did not cause it.

Repro: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_panes.py::test_bench_axe_jk`
(or the full `tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py` re-export) on athena under ordinary
shared-host load.

Do not weaken `_AXE_P95_BUDGET_MS` (tests/ace/tui/_bench_tui_jk_helpers.py) to get
green. Root cause is unknown: either the cached Services/Axe j/k paint path regressed
past budget, or the 16 ms budget was never calibrated for a loaded athena (the same open
question as sase-1ge for the Fleet fault scenarios). Profile the Services j/k
key-to-paint path first, using the per-sample perf rows the bench now isolates.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Three slow runs over two trees all exceed 16 ms p95 on next (34.3, 38.6, 35.6 ms), with complete, correctly scoped 20+20 sample windows; the clean base shows the same latency, so this is a persistent budget miss rather than an intermittent failure.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1vy.3 isolated the Services j/k sample window (sase-199), which unmasked a p95 budget miss that reproduces identically on the clean base; no task names this node.
